quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Highway entrance ramp.
Road widens.
Right lane ends.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: The same thing as a yield sign.
The light is about to turn green.
The same thing as a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an upcoming corner. You must yield to:

options.text: Oncoming vehicles also turning left.
All approaching vehicles.
Pedestrians on the sidewalk waiting for a "Walk" signal.

questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to all vehicles coming toward you, pedestrians, and bicyclists who have a green light.

questions.question: Which road surface freezes first?

options.text: A tunnel
An intersection
A bridge

questions.explanation: Bridges freeze before other roads because they are exposed on both sides. They thaw out later than surrounding roads.

questions.question: When can you legally turn left at a red traffic light after stopping?

options.text: You are traveling on a two-way street and turning onto a two-way street.
You are traveling on a one-way street and turning onto another one-way street.
You yield to all other traffic at the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are traveling on a one-way street and turning onto another one-way street.
questions.explanation: After a complete stop, you may turn left at a red light only if you are on a one-way street turning onto another one-way street. Check for signs that prohibit this turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Merging traffic.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Directions for children
School zone ahead
Playground area ahead

questions.explanation: Five-sided signs show you are near or entering a school zone. Watch for children and obey the speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must turn left.
No left turn.
No U-turn.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. Turning left here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Go 35 mph or slower when approaching the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go 35 mph or slower when approaching the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed to use.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look both ways before going.

questions.question: You are being passed on both sides while driving in the center lane of an expressway. What should you do?

options.text: Stay in the center lane.
Move to the right lane.
Move to the left lane.

questions.explanation: On roads with four or more lanes, use the right lanes unless you are passing or turning left. On interstate highways, use the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.

questions.question: When should you NOT use your horn?

options.text: When you cannot see far ahead.
If you might hit another vehicle.
Near blind pedestrians.

questions.explanation: Do not use your horn near blind pedestrians. It can be dangerous. Yield to the pedestrian and continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a yellow left turn arrow mean?

options.text: Get ready to yield to oncoming traffic.
The protected left turn is ending.
Both of the above.

questions.explanation: A yellow left turn arrow means the protected turn is ending. You must prepare to yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are going the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
Wait until it turns green to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: If your car is about to be hit from behind, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Release your seat belt.
Brace yourself.
Push your head against the headrest.

questions.explanation: Keep your seat belt on. Brace yourself and press your head against the headrest to prevent whiplash. Hold the steering wheel firmly and be ready to brake.

questions.question: When you plan to pass another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Not assume the other driver will make room for you to return to your lane.
Assume the other driver will let you pass if you signal.
Assume the other driver will keep the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not assume the other driver will make room for you to return to your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will give you space or the right-of-way, even if you signal.

questions.question: When leaving an alley or driveway to enter traffic, drivers should:

options.text: Stop only if pedestrians are on the sidewalk.
Stop before driving onto the sidewalk.
Expect pedestrians to yield to you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before driving onto the sidewalk.
questions.explanation: You must stop before entering the sidewalk. Pedestrians and traffic have the right-of-way.

questions.question: On an interstate, how can you avoid traffic merging from on-ramps on your right?

options.text: Move to the left lane.
Slow down.
Keep your speed and position.

questions.explanation: When traffic permits, move to the left lane to give vehicles room to enter from the on-ramps.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?

options.text: An intersection.
A crosswalk.
A railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: A round sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: In fog, rain, or snow, which headlights should you use?

options.text: Low beams.
High beams.
Fog lights only.

questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, rain, and snow. High beams reflect back and create glare, making it harder to see.

questions.question: Driving too fast:

options.text: Does not increase the chance of a crash.
Improves your ability to react to danger.
Often leads to risky decisions.

questions.explanation: Driving too fast is a common cause of crashes. It does not save time and often leads to risky decisions.

questions.question: When driving at night on a dimly lit street, you should:

options.text: Drive slowly enough to stop within the area lit by your headlights.
Use high beam headlights to see vehicles ahead of you better.
Keep your instrument panel lights bright so other drivers can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly enough to stop within the area lit by your headlights.
questions.explanation: You should drive slower at night than during the day because you cannot see as far ahead. Make sure you can stop within the area lit by your headlights.

questions.question: Which statement is true about work zones?

options.text: Fines for violations in work zones are the same as in normal traffic.
You must slow down for the cone zone.
Slow down only if you see workers present.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must slow down for the cone zone.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed and be ready to slow down or stop for road equipment. Driving carefully through work zones keeps drivers, pedestrians, bicyclists, and road workers safe.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection with a steady yellow light. If you have not entered the intersection, you should:

options.text: Speed up to pass through before the red light.
Reduce your speed and proceed carefully through the intersection.
Come to a safe stop.

questions.explanation: At a steady yellow light, bring your vehicle to a safe stop. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, continue through at a safe speed.

questions.question: The best way to avoid a dangerous situation while driving is to:

options.text: Know what is happening around your vehicle.
Turn off the radio.
Always look straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Know what is happening around your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Always be aware of what is happening around your vehicle. Look to the front, sides, and rear to see problems early. This helps you change speed or position safely.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
The road curves ahead.
There are upcoming intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: You should increase the distance between your vehicle and the one ahead when you:

options.text: Are following a small passenger vehicle.
Are being tailgated by another driver.
Are driving slower than the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are being tailgated by another driver.
questions.explanation: When being tailgated, add extra space in front of your vehicle and do not brake suddenly. Slow down gradually or change lanes to prevent a collision.

questions.question: In traffic moving at 50 to 55 mph, you are least likely to have an accident if you:

options.text: Drive a few miles per hour faster than most other vehicles.
Stay within that speed range.
Drive a few miles per hour slower than most other vehicles.

questions.explanation: Drive at the same speed as other traffic (within posted speed limits). Vehicles moving at the same speed in the same direction cannot crash into each other. Crashes often happen when vehicles drive at different speeds.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:

options.text: Right turn.
Intersection.
Lane change.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
Always stop.
Divided highway ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right into your lane. Be ready to let incoming traffic merge safely.
